_comment: red-pill settings fragment for Claude Code. Merged (not overwritten) into settings.json by scripts/inject_settings.py. Grants the agent access to its transversal dirs OUTSIDE the workspace. NO defaultMode here on purpose: autonomous bypass is a per-launch CLI flag, never a shared-session default.
_comment_hooks: Stop hook = RAW CAPTURE LAYER for Claude Code, symmetric to the opencode scribe plugin. Deterministically writes each turn's prompt+response into bunker.db interactions, so capture no longer depends on the agent invoking the handshake relay. Script deployed to ~/.claude/hooks/ by inject_settings.py from seeds/settings/hooks/.
